title: Anlam Cesaret Ölüm Hiçlik
author: Ferhat Jak İçöz
description: Meaning, Courage, Death, Nothingness is a comprehensive introduction to existential psychotherapy, an approach centered on the human search for meaning, freedom, responsibility, and encounters with death and nothingness. Rather than aiming for change through predefined goals, existential therapy invites clients to encounter themselves more fully. Through reflective questioning and therapeutic dialogue, individuals gain awareness of their choices, limits, and possibilities, allowing freedom to emerge through understanding rather than prescription.
